notas_originais: v. אַטִּיפָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: tropas irregulares ou indisciplinadas; possível leitura do grego ἄτακτοι.
definicoes_originais: , prob. אֲטַקְטִין or אֲטַקְטֵי m. pl. (ἄτακτοι) undisciplined, irregular troops.
notas_originais: Pesik. Ekhah p. 122 b (explaining: ‘thy princes are rebels’ Is. I, 23) אדוניך מריונים דהוו מזיינין א' ‘thy lords are rebels’—for they equipped irregulars. [This seems to be the proper version restored from Ar. a. Var.; v. Pesik. l. c. note 75.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: canhoto; indivíduo com a mão direita inábil.
notas_originais: ), sub. יד ימינו one whose right hand is tied up or unfit for labor; left-handed. Sabb. 103 a אי' יד. Men. 37 a only א'. Tosef. Bekh. V, 8 א' בין בידיו וכ'; Bekh. 45 b א' בין ביד וכ' one either left-handed or left-legged (v. Rashi a. l.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: Trípoli, cidade da costa fenícia.
definicoes_originais: Tripolis, on the coast of Phœnicia.
notas_originais: Y. Sabb. III, 6 c top; (Bab. ib. 45 b Sidon).

verbetes.glosa_atual: laranja; laranjeira ou fruto; ver אֶתְרוֹגָא.
notas_originais: Targ. Cant. II, 3 (h. text תפוח, some ed. אֶתְ'). Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41 a bot.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אִיטְרֹון.
notas_originais: v. אִיטְרֹון

verbetes.glosa_atual: massa conservada; preparação alimentar em tiras, semelhante a aletria.
definicoes_originais: (נטר; cmp. הִטְּרִי a. טָרִית) prop. something preserved, hence dough preserved, vermicelli.
notas_originais: Y. Ḥall. I, 57 d bot. as I intend making אצוותי א' my dough into vermicelli. Y. Bets. I, 60 d הדא אטריתא וכ' to make verm. (on Holy Days), if for drying them, it is forbidden &c.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Traconítide, região a leste da Gaulanítide.
definicoes_originais: Trachonitis, a district east of Gaulanitis.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. II, Deut. III, 14 (h. Argob). V. טרכונא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: folha de planta; equivalente de טַרְפָּא.
notas_originais: Git. 69 b (collect.).— Pl. אַטְרְפִין, אַטְרְפֵי. Targ. Ps. I, 3. B. Mets. 114 b (Var. טרפי, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: prefixo אִי־; ver אִ־.
notas_originais: prefix, v. אִ־

verbetes.glosa_atual: forma feminina de אוּ.
notas_originais: fem. of אוּ q. v.

verbetes.glosa_atual: se; quer... quer...; conjunção condicional ou alternativa.
notas_originais: Targ. Cant. VII, 13; a. e.—Ber. 2 a, a. fr. אי הכי (abbrev. א"ה) if this be so (introducing an argument against one’s opinion).—R. Hash. 3 a כי משמש וכ' khi has four meanings, אי if, &c.—אי נמי (abbrev. א"נ) a) if you choose, it may also be said; or. B. Mets. 98 a; a. fr.—b) even if, v. נַמִּי. Ḥull. 12 a א"נ דילמא וכ' (Rashi א"נ שמע איניש וכ') even if somebody else overheard it; a. fr.—אי אמרת בשלמא (abbr. אא"ב = בשלמא אי אמרת) I grant, if you were to say … היינו then would be right what &c.; v. בשלמא. Yoma 17 b; a. fr.—אי … אי whether … or. Targ. Koh. XI, 6. B. Mets. 98 a; a. fr.
adv. of interrogation, v. אִין II. Targ. Job XI, 2 Ms. (ed. אין).

verbetes.glosa_atual: não; negação em expressões como אי אפשר, impossível.
notas_originais: Git. IV, 5 אי אפשר it is impossible. Keth. XII, 3 אי אפשי I want not; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: há; existe; forma abreviada de אִית.
definicoes_originais: (abbr. of אִית, as לי = לית) there is.
notas_originais: Y. Snh. VI, 23 b bot. אי בי וכ' there is in me (the possibility of) doing, i.e. I can do it. Ib. מה אי וכ' what is it thou canst do? (v. Y. Ḥag. II, 78 a top).

verbetes.glosa_atual: ah!; ei!; ai!; interjeição de apelo ou lamento.
definicoes_originais: Interj. Eh! Oh! Woe! Targ. Y. II, Lev. XXVI, 29.
notas_originais: —Taan. 7 a אי חכמה וכ' Oh, for such a brilliant mind in such an ugly vessel (body)! R. Hash. 19 a אי שמים Oh heavens!; a. fr. Y. Shek. V, end, 49 b אי לי שאני וכ' woe unto me, that I thus see thee! Y. Yeb. XIII, 14 a top; a. fr. [Babli, usually אֹוי.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: onde?; qual?; como?; de onde?
definicoes_originais: (אֵיי) h. a. ch. (b. h. אֵי, אַיֵה) where? what? how?—אי מנן whence? Targ. Josh. II, 4; a. e.
notas_originais: —Hebr. אי זה (often אֵיזֶה, אֵזֶה in one word) who? which? Y. Kil. VIII, beg. 31 b לאי זה דבר נאמר with regard to what (in what way, sense) has it been said? Y. Shebi. I, beg. 33 a ואי זה זה and which (ploughing time) is this?; a. v. fr.—Y. Peah III, 17 c top ואיי דינו מירוג (= אידין) and what is the meaning of merog? Kerith. 6 b לאיי מיצרך צריכי what need is there (of the others)? Cmp. אֵיזֶה; אֵימָתי; כֵּיצַד.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אֵב.
notas_originais: v. אֵב

verbetes.glosa_atual: fruto; crescimento ou produto de planta.
notas_originais: Targ. Gen. IV, 3; a. e.; v. אִנְבָּא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: pai; variante de אַבָּא; homógrafo de fruto.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Num. XXX, 4; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: forma relacionada a אִיבָּא, fruto; plural איבְבַיָּא.
notas_originais: I, pl. איבְבַיָּא. Targ. I Kings VI, 38 (ed. Vien. אִבְּבַיָא).

verbetes.glosa_atual: inimizade; hostilidade; rancor; aversão.
notas_originais: Snh. III, 5 an enemy is he who has not spoken to his neighbor for three days בא' in his grudge; a. fr.—משום (מפני) א' for the sake of preventing ill-feeling. Y. Dem. IV, 24 a; a. fr.
Y. Yoma VIII, 44 d bot. הכלה מפני א' the bride (is permitted to wash her face on the Day of Atone.) that she may not lose her attraction.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ave de rapina, como abutre ou milhafre, de identificação zoológica antiga.
notas_originais: cmp. אבל) [ black], name of a bird (h. אֲנָפָה) vulture or kite. Targ. O. Lev. XI, 19; Deut. XIV, 18 (Targ. Y. אוכמתא). [Targ. Y. I, II Deut. XIV, 13; 14, gloss to v. 18; confounded with v. 13—h. text אַיָּה.]—אִיבּוּ pr. n. m., v. אִבּוּ.

verbetes.glosa_atual: perdição; ruína; destruição.
notas_originais: Ab. Zar. 33 a אזיל לא' is wasted. Ḥull. 11 b משום א' נשמה to prevent loss of life (to save the convict). Bets. 22 a אִבּוּד ממון pecuniary loss; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: luto; lamentação pela morte; ver אֲבֵילוּת.
notas_originais: Yeb. IV, 10; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: forma aramaica de luto; ver אִבּ׳.
notas_originais: ch., v. אִבּ'

verbetes.glosa_atual: alimentação forçada de animal; introdução de comida pela garganta.
definicoes_originais: (אָבַס) stuffing, forcing food down the animal’s throat.
notas_originais: Erub. 20 b (first time) והא אי' כמאן וכ' in stuffing, is it not as if taking a vessel in hand &c.? [Second time והא א' כמאן וכ' omitted in Ms. M.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: mulheres encarregadas de acender as lâmpadas e cuidar da iluminação.
definicoes_originais: (prob. contr. of איבעיר'; בער), א' דזהרא lamp-lighters, hand-maids who attended to the lights.
notas_originais: Y. Yoma III, beg. 40 b; Y. R. Hash. II, beg. 57 d R. … handled things forbidden to handle on the Sabbath על פום א' דז' (Y. R. Hash. l. c., insert פום) on the lamplighters’ declaring that night had set in (חשיכה מוצאי שבת). [The context proves that our w. designates a person or persons.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: equivalente a אֶבְלָא; luto.
notas_originais: . Targ. O. Gen. L, 10; a. e. ed. Berl., oth. ed. אֶבְלָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אֲבֵילִין.
notas_originais: , v. אֲבֵילִין

verbetes.glosa_atual: caso queiras; se desejas; ou então.
definicoes_originais: (= אִי בָּעִית, v. בעי) if thou so desirest; or.
notas_originais: וא' אימא—א' אימא (abbr. אב"א) if you choose, I may say … or if you prefer (another solution) I may say … Yoma 28 b; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אֵבֶר; variantes plurais אֵיבָרִים e אֵיבָרִין.
membro corporal; também órgão genital.
notas_originais: Targ. Job. II, 4 (Ms. אֶיבְרָא). Yoma 25 b.—Trnsf. arm, wing, pinion. Sabb. 90 b א' דשמאלא left arm.— Pl. אֵיבָרִין, אֵיבָרַיָּא. Targ. Lev. I, 8, a. e. ( pieces). Targ. Ezek. XVII, 3; Deut. XXXII, 11 (wings).
Targ. Y. Gen. XIV, 2; I ibid. XLIX, 24.—[B. Mets. 84 a, v. אִיבְרָיָה.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: com efeito; certamente; na verdade.
definicoes_originais: (אבר to be strong) indeed, to be sure.
notas_originais: Ḥull. 59 b א' חזינא ליה indeed, I should like to see him. Git. 56 b top א' מלכא את indeed, thou art a sovereign.

verbetes.glosa_atual: quantidade suficiente para refeição doméstica.
definicoes_originais: (v. next w.) enough for a meal in the household.
notas_originais: Erub. 82 b תרתי רִיפָתָא א' Ms. M. (ed. איכרייתא, Asheri, ed. Ven. כברייתא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) two large loaves of the household (or of mourners’ meals). [Rashi, expl. our w. as loaves of drivers of oxen, appears to have had before him the vers. of Ms. M. and to derive our w. from ברא, v. בַּר I a. אֲפַר.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: refeição; alimento servido à mesa.
notas_originais: B. Mets. 84 a א' דר' וכ' one meal of R. Ismael &c. (v. Rabb. D. S. to איבריאתא, Erub. 82 b, note
; cmp. Pesik. B’shall. p. 90 b sq., a. Ber. 44 a). [Some read אֵיבָרֵיה v. אֵיבָרָא 2).]

verbetes.glosa_atual: Jastrow propõe ler אִיכָּרָיו; ver אִיכָּר.
notas_originais: Y. M. Kat. III, 82 b bot. read אִיכָּרָיו; v. אִיכָּר. [V. however, אִיבְרָיָאתָא end.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver הֹובְרָיָּא.
notas_originais: Y. M. Kat. III, end, 83 d, v. הֹובְרָיָּא

notas_originais: , v. אֵגֶד

notas_originais: v. אֵגֹור a. אֲגֹורָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: equivalente de אִיגָרָא; telhado.
notas_originais: . Targ. Zeph. I, 5 (pl.) אִיגּוּריָּא (ed. Vien. אֱגֹו').

notas_originais: Arakh. 32 a; Meg. 5 b שור א' a city line formed by joining roofs, opp. חֹומָה.—

verbetes.glosa_atual: telhado; cobertura; forma aramaica de אִיגָר.
definicoes_originais: (also אִיגּ' with Dagesh) const. אִיגַר same.
notas_originais: Targ. Prov. XXI, 9; a. fr.—Ruth. R. to I, 17 (Par. 3) איגר פלטין roof of the palace. Git. 85 b (Rashi איגרת, corr. acc.), v. אִגֶּרֶת.— Pl. אִיגָרַיָּא, אִיגָרַיָּיא; אִיגָרֵי. Targ. II Kings XIX, 26; a. e.—Y. Pes. VII, 35 b (Cant. R. to II, 14 אברייאה, corr. acc.); v. זֵיתָא I. Lam. R. introd. (R. Yoḥ.
ולא' סלקין and they ascend the roofs. Pes. 111 b דבי א' those (demons) dwelling on roofs.

verbetes.glosa_atual: carta; ver אִיגַּרְתָּא.
ver אַגְרֹונִימֹוס.
notas_originais: q. v.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אִגֶּרֶת.
notas_originais: , v. אִגֶּרֶת

verbetes.glosa_atual: carta; epístola; documento escrito; carta de recomendação ou honra.
definicoes_originais: f. אִיגְּרָא m. (= h. אִגֶּרֶת) letter &c. Targ. II Kings V. 5; a. fr.—Y. Ned. X, end, 42 b, a. e. א' דאיקר letter of honor, recommendation.
notas_originais: Sabb. 115 a; a. fr.—B. Mets. 83 b; Snh. 82 a; 96 a (prov.) קריינא דא' איהו ליהוי פרוונקא let him who composed the letter be himself its carrier.— Pl. (of אִיגְּרָא) אִיגְּרִין. Targ. Y. II Num. XXII, 7 אִגְּ'.—Targ. Is. XXXIX, 1.—אִיגָּרָן, אִיגָּרָאן, אִיגָּרָתָא, אִיגָּרָאתָא. Targ. I Kings XXI, 9; a. fr.—Y. Keth. II, 26 b bot. Y. Ned. VI, 40 a bot. Y. Snh. I, 19 a top.

verbetes.glosa_atual: dia marcado; data; má sorte; adversidade; aniversário e festa idolátrica em contextos próprios.
notas_originais: Gen. R. s. 13, v. אֵד.

Ab. Zar. 7 b יום אֵידָם the very day of their festival.— Pl. אֵידִים. Ib. I, 2, a. fr. (של נכרים) אֵידֵיהֶן. Ib. 2 a; Y. Erub. V, beg. 22 a (controversy as to spelling with א' or with ע). [As to cacophemistic designation, cmp. אבידן &c.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: equivalente aramaico de אֵיד; variantes עֵידָא e עֵדָא.
notas_originais: Targ. Esth. I, 3. Targ. Prov. VII, 20.

notas_originais: , v. אֵידֵין a. הֵידָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: mão; vocábulo presente em determinados Targumim.
definicoes_originais: (= ידא; v. אִ־) hand (only in Targ. Y.).
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Deut. IX, 26; a. fr.— Pl. אִידַיָּא, אַיְדַיָּא, אִידֵי. Targ. Ps. XXIV, 4; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: este; isto mesmo; o mesmo; homógrafo de mão.
definicoes_originais: (= אִי דָא, v. אוּ a. דָּא) this, the same.
notas_originais: Y. Erub. III, 21 b bot. הדא אמרה אי א' אי א' this proves this is this, this is that, i.e. it is the same. [Ib. היא הדא היא הדא.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: lã; ver אוּדְדָא e אִירָא.
água, do grego ὕδωρ.
notas_originais: Succ. 35 a; v. הִידֹור.

notas_originais: v. אַדְווּתָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: plural de אִידֵּךְ.
notas_originais: pl. of אִידֵּךְ.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Idi ou Idit, nome de um amora.
notas_originais: Y. Yoma VII, beg. 44 a. Snh. 38 b; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: quem, afinal?; o que agora?; qual?; em uso elíptico, o que queres?
definicoes_originais: who now? what now? which now? ( quisnam, quidnam).
(ellipt.) what do you want? Y. B. Kam. V, beg. 4 d, v. הֵידָא.
notas_originais: Targ. I Sam. VI, 20. Targ. Jer. II, 10; a. fr.—Tam. 32 a א' מתקרי חכים who is to be called wise? Lam. R. to I, 1 (חד מאת' 4) אחמי לי אידא וכ' show me now which of these is from a white goat &c. Y. Pes. II, 28 c top ואיידא אמר דא what (passage) now says this (is this derived from)? Y. Sot. V, 20 c bot. ואיידי חובתא עבדית and what is the sin I have committed? Lam. R. to III, 7 באידנא אסטרטיא וכ' by which road did you come?

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אוּד׳; remissão abreviada.
notas_originais: , v. אוּדְ'

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אִידִי.
notas_originais: , v. אִידִי

verbetes.glosa_atual: este; aquele; outro; diverso. No plural, אִידֵּי; expressão א׳ וא׳ significa ambos.
definicoes_originais: a. fem. (= דֵּךְ, with אִי prosth.
notas_originais: ) this, that, freq. the other, another. Yeb. 62 a; a. fr. תניא א' another (author or Boraitha) teaches. Ib. 22 b בא' קרא in another verse. B. Mets. 98 b וא' לא ידענא and as to the other (cow), I don’t know; a. fr.— Pl. אִידֵּי.—א' וא' these and those, i.e. both. Yeb. 8 a; a. fr.

notas_originais: Sabb. II, 1, expl. in Babli (20 b) אחוינא, v. אַחְוָונָא 3), in Y. (4 c) עידניתא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אֵידֵין.
notas_originais: v. אֵידֵין

verbetes.glosa_atual: tempo; ocasião; época; período.
notas_originais: —הָאִידְּנָא this time, now, to-day. Targ. Y. Deut. I, 6 (usu. with ע).—Yeb. 62 a לילא דהא' this night. Yoma 19 b הא' יומא וכ' to-day is the Day of Atone. Ber. 4 a כי הא' at this very time (hour). Kid. 71 b והא' דאיכא רמאי but now-a-days when there are deceivers; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אִדַּר.
notas_originais: v. אִדַּר

verbetes.glosa_atual: bebida ou sidra de marmelo, do grego ὑδρόμηλον.
notas_originais: Y. Shebi. III, beg. 37 b

verbetes.glosa_atual: recinto; cômodo fechado; quarto; alcova; dormitório.
notas_originais: idrânu, v. Fred. Del. Hebr. Lang. p. 24; cmp. חֵדֶר) an enclosure, chamber, esp. dark alcove, bed-room. Targ. Job XXXVII, 9. Meg. 26 b איד' דהוה וכ' a room where the corpse was placed before burial. B. Bath. 7 a השתא משוית לי איד' ed. (Ms. M. והשתא אינד') now thou makest my (formerly open) compartment a lightless alcove. Ḥull. 52 b; a. e.—Men. 33 b (fem.) א' מעלייתא a fine room. B. Kam. 85 b, v. הַרְזֵק. Taan. 25 a עיילא לאינ' she went up to the bed-room.

verbetes.glosa_atual: mesmo que אִידְּרֹון, verbete precedente.

expressão corrompida em Eclesiastes Rabá sobre o anjo da morte.
notas_originais: , Koh. R. to IV, 7 זו אידרתו של מלאך המות (Var. in Y’dê Mosheh a. l. של א"ה), a corruption of a mutilated clause, part of which is to be found in Deut. R. s. 2 where Prov. XXIV, 21 is reprehended and Solomon is made to emend it with Koh. IV, 8 יש אחד ואין שני. The passage restored would probably read: זו ירא את ר' בני ומלך עם וג'. אמר ר' אחא כעס הקב"ה … חזר ופירש את הדבר יש אחד ואין שני וכ'.
